messages:
Iris (Product): Velox asked for a compact multimodal summary beta next week. Need a quick owner map + showstoppers.
Sam (Eng): Timeline tight. Key unknown: image+text token alignment and API shape.
Ravi (Runtime): Runtime needs a shim for treating image embeddings as pseudo-tokens and a KV-cache TTL tweak. Prototype requires a staging GPU pool.
Zoe (Infra): I can carve 2x A10g in staging for 72h. Tell me expected peak GPU mem and if we need mTLS.
Ravi (Runtime): Peak ~18GB GPU mem, ephemeral disk for image decode only. Batch: 6 users, ~400 tokens + 1 image (~1.2MB). mTLS for staging yes.
Lina (Security): Images are PII risk. Requirements: no persistent storage, strip EXIF, short-lived signed uploads, scoped SSO access. I need 48h for a threat review; if delayed, we enforce mitigations.
Carmen (CS): Velox signed DPA and will run 500 beta users. They want rollback criteria and acceptance rubric.
Sam (Eng): Proposed API: POST /v1/compact_summary {text, images:[url|base64], opts:{mode}}. Degrade to text-only with 200 + warn header on image failure.
Ravi (Runtime): I can add a fast-fail for oversized images (>2MB) and a cache-bypass flag. ETA 36h for code + unit tests.
Zoe (Infra): Provisioning command I'll run tonight (staging internal-only):
```
terraform apply -var='env=staging' -var='pool=velox-beta' -var='gpu_type=A10g' -auto-approve
```
I'll also set up a restricted subdomain and mTLS certs.
Lina (Security): Interim mitigations if review misses 48h: upload TTL=30s, limited SSO group, no analytics export. I'll post checklist by EOD.
Sam (Eng): Rollout plan: feature flag -> canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Need a gateway kill-switch and runtime fast-fail hook.
Iris (Product): Action items recap:
- Lina: threat checklist + confirmation  by EOD (security)
- Zoe: staging GPU pool + mTLS endpoint  tonight (infra)
- Ravi: image-embedding shim + cache tweak + fast-fail + tests  36h (runtime)
- Sam: API spec + e2e fixtures + perf script  48h (eng)
- Carmen: Velox beta window + acceptance cases  today (CS)
deploy-bot: Staging endpoint created: https://staging.velox.redwood.internal/compact-beta (mTLS).
Sam (Eng): I'll open a PR with the API contract and sample payloads in this thread. If blockers appear, let's call a 15m sync.
Iris (Product): Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the threat checklist. :white_check_mark:
